_comment: Copy this file to mcp_servers.json to give ELI tools from external MCP servers.
Each entry is a local program ELI launches on demand and speaks to over stdio —
nothing here opens a network connection, so it stays inside ELI's offline-by-default
posture. Servers start on first use, not at boot, so an entry you are not using
costs nothing and a broken one cannot delay startup.
Ask ELI 'what MCP servers do I have' or 'list my MCP tools' to see what it found,
including the real reason for anything that failed to start.

eli._comment: ELI exposing its own actions — useful for testing the loop end to end.
